surfaces.text: On a given straight line to describe a parallelepipedal solid similar and similarly situated to a given parallelepipedal solid.
在一条特定的直线上描述平行管道固体,与特定平行管道固体类似和类似。

Let AB be the given straight line and CD the given parallelepipedal solid; thus it is required to describe on the given straight line AB a parallelepipedal solid similar and similarly situated to the given parallelepipedal solid CD.
让AB是给定的直线,CD是给定的平行管道固体;因此,需要在给定的直线AB上描述一个平行管道固体,与给定的平行管道固体CD类似和类似。

For on the straight line AB and at the point A on it let the solid angle, contained by the angles BAH, HAK, KAB, be constructed equal to the solid angle at C, so that the angle BAH is equal to the angle ECF, the angle BAK equal to the angle ECG, and the angle KAH to the angle GCF; and let it be contrived that, as EC is to CG, so is BA to AK, and, as GC is to CF, so is KA to AH. [[VI. 12](/principles/euclid-6-12)]
直线AB和A点的BAH和KAB角的固角,在C时等于固角,BAH角等于ECF角,BAK角等于ECG角,KAH角等于GCF角;并想象,EC比CG等于BA比AK,GC比CF等于KA比AH；EC 与 CG 之比等于 BA 与 AK 之比；GC 与 CF 之比等于 KA 与 AH 之比。（相关点与线段：HAK） [[VI. 12](/principles/euclid-6-12)]
Therefore also, ex aequali, as EC is to CF, so is BA to AH. [[V. 22](/principles/euclid-5-22)]
因此,在平等的基础上,EC对CF的比等于BA对AH的比；EC 与 CF 之比等于 BA 与 AH 之比。 [[V. 22](/principles/euclid-5-22)]
Let the parallelogram HB and the solid AL be completed.
完成平行四边形、HB 和AL固体
Now since, as EC is to CG, so is BA to AK, and the sides about the equal angles ECG, BAK are thus proportional, therefore the parallelogram GE is similar to the parallelogram KB.
现在,EC比CG等于BA比AK,而两边的角角相等的ECG比BAK等于成比例,因此平行四边形比GE与平行四边形、KB相似；EC 与 CG 之比等于 BA 与 AK 之比。

For the same reason the parallelogram KH is also similar to the parallelogram GF, and further FE to HB; therefore three parallelograms of the solid CD are similar to three parallelograms of the solid AL.
出于同样原因,平行四边形 KH也与平行四边形 GF类似,还有FE至HB;因此,CD固体中的3 平行四边形与AL固体中的3 平行四边形相似。

But the former three are both equal and similar to the three opposite parallelograms, and the latter three are both equal and similar to the three opposite parallelograms; therefore the whole solid CD is similar to the whole solid AL. [[XI. Def. 9](/principles/euclid-11-def-9)]
但前三个是平等的,与对立的3个是相似的,后三个是平等的,与对立的3个是相似的;因此,整个CD固体与整块AL固体是相似的。 [[XI. Def. 9](/principles/euclid-11-def-9)]
Therefore on the given straight line AB there has been described AL similar and similarly situated to the given parallelepipedal solid CD. Q. E. F.
因此,在给定的AB直线上,有AL相似和类似位置的线条,与给定的平行管道固体CD. Q.E.F。
